description: This file defines the Schedule class within the OrangeHRM Framework's console scheduling module. It manages scheduling tasks, including adding, retrieving, and filtering tasks based on due status, while also generating unique identifiers for tasks.

classes.name: Schedule
classes.description: Manages scheduled tasks within the OrangeHRM framework, providing methods to add, retrieve, set, and filter tasks based on their due status, along with generating unique IDs for tasks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Schedule object with dependencies on Console and OutputInterface.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new task based on provided CommandInfo, excluding certain commands, and returns the created Task.

methods.name: getTasks
methods.description: Returns the list of all scheduled tasks.

methods.name: setTasks
methods.description: Replaces the current task list with the provided array of Task objects.

methods.name: getDueTasks
methods.description: Filters and returns tasks that are due within a specified timezone.

methods.name: generateUniqueId
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier for a task command, ensuring no collisions within current tasks.
